findings.summary: A plan-only Terraform baseline and exact-head test recovery evidence exist, but no independently verified AWS environment, managed backup/PITR, deployed telemetry or production runtime exists.
Main is strictly protected with required checks/review/admin enforcement; Actions are selected and SHA-pinned; exact-source-head CI and attestation passed.
Six historical visual-review failures remain preserved and are explicitly superseded by cumulative C2 Runtime Visual Review run 29660653755 after the shared whitespace defect was removed.
Pages publication is manual, main-only and requires explicit DEMO_NON_PRODUCTION confirmation; policy tests reject automatic triggers.
Owned canonical documentation now distinguishes the static demo, local runtime foundation and missing production evidence.
Canonical documentation now states that the unkeyed hash chains are neither signatures nor immutable external evidence.
AutoSkills, Context7, skill usage and dependency-safe fallback records now exist and are fail-closed validated.
Locks/audits, restricted SHA-pinned Actions, alerts, deterministic SBOM/provenance/checksums and exact-source-head GitHub OIDC attestations are verified.

production_gates.reason: Guided intake and evidence-governed candidate workspace are draft-PR CI-green with read-only ES/EN surfaces; authenticated editing, dedicated reviewer separation, human acceptance and live environments remain absent.

A governed bilingual repository catalog, exact-authorized assignment/progress API, bounded assessments, forced PostgreSQL RLS, append-only completion receipts, and accessible Team-chapter journeys pass locally. Exact-head hosted evidence, independent human acceptance, managed environments, external LMS/provider review, and professional accreditation remain absent.

Structured logs, trace context, authenticated low-cardinality metrics and alert rules pass locally and at the exact PR head; deployed collectors, dashboards, routing, retention and staging SLO evidence are absent.
Native PostgreSQL 18 backup and isolated restore passed at the exact PR head with a retained checksum artifact; managed encrypted backups, PITR, retention and operator evidence are absent.
Exact-head PostgreSQL 18 isolated restore passed with Alembic and all-public-table count validation; managed staging application/RLS smoke and measured, human-approved RPO/RTO remain absent.

The fail-closed rollback policy, migration catalog, exact-head PostgreSQL 18 rehearsal, merged source and post-merge receipt pass. Managed staging artifact rollback, PITR, accepted RPO/RTO and production recovery remain unverified.
Bounded authenticated local/hosted PostgreSQL 18 contention evidence exists, but managed staging capacity, accepted thresholds, edge behavior and production load evidence remain absent.
